description: Indeed job search (US): title, company, location, salary range, job type, posting date and link for the first page of results (up to ~15 jobs) for a keyword and location, read from indeed.com's public search page through a residential proxy. Rankings and salaries are as Indeed shows them; no job descriptions. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
